topic: TLS1.3早期数据重放风险控制
title: 阻断真实 TLS1.3 早期写请求，验收425与正常握手重试
review_note: 独立本地验收：参考产物通过，初始产物和典型错误实现未通过；真实集群和外部服务不在本轮执行范围。
rubric: 解释题设中的因果关系和证据边界
比较方案约束而非套用单一参数
给出可验证的判断或处理顺序
body:
## 环境与初始材料
非root Linux、Nginx（OpenSSL TLS1.3）、openssl CLI、Python3。提供gateway.conf待修配置；验收临时生成测试证书、启动一个1worker高端口Nginx和可记录写入的回环上游，使用openssl s_client实际会话票据和-early_data发出0-RTT。

## 操作任务
修复gateway.conf，在保留TLS1.3和ssl_early_data on前提下，通过Nginx真实$ssl_early_data状态拒绝POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE早期数据，进入上游前返回425。GET早期数据仍可成功；完成正常握手后同一写请求可执行一次。不要信任客户端伪造Early-Data头来判断是否0-RTT，向上游的Early-Data必须重建为真实TLS状态（普通请求移除），不要关闭早期数据或一律阻断POST来绕过任务。保留@PORT@/@ROOT@/@UPSTREAM@占位符，由验收渲染为临时回环服务，不修改宿主Nginx。

## 提交产物
修复的gateway.conf；验收生成verified-evidence.json，记录实际到达上游的请求和TLS协议/早期返回状态。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py 先nginx -t，再获取真实TLS1.3会话票据且确认允许Early Data；分别发送4类实际早期写请求，要求425且上游零写入，随后正常握手重试各执行一次。实际早期GET仍200且带可信标记；普通POST伪造Early-Data:1不得影响判断或传递伪造标记。最后退出临时服务。全部断言通过退出0。不宣称TLS本身为所有业务请求提供幂等；生产重试仍需业务幂等策略。

失败示例：用$http_early_data而不是$ssl_early_data判定，只要客户端不发对应HTTP头，真实早期POST就会穿透并被上游执行。

exercise.operation: 修复gateway.conf，在保留TLS1.3和ssl_early_data on前提下，通过Nginx真实$ssl_early_data状态拒绝POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE早期数据，进入上游前返回425。GET早期数据仍可成功；完成正常握手后同一写请求可执行一次。不要信任客户端伪造Early-Data头来判断是否0-RTT，向上游的Early-Data必须重建为真实TLS状态（普通请求移除），不要关闭早期数据或一律阻断POST来绕过任务。保留@PORT@/@ROOT@/@UPSTREAM@占位符，由验收渲染为临时回环服务，不修改宿主Nginx。
exercise.verification: 真实TLS1.3票据与Early Data请求、Nginx状态、上游写入计数、正常重试与伪造头对照
failure_examples: 信任HTTP Early-Data头，漏拦实际0-RTT写入

test_files.checks/check.py:
import pathlib,json,subprocess,socket,threading,http.server,contextlib,time,os,signal
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();seen=[]
class Handler(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self,*args):pass
    def handle_request(self):
        body=self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')))
        seen.append({'method':self.command,'path':self.path,'body':body.decode(),'early':self.headers.get('Early-Data')})
        answer=b'accepted';self.send_response(200);self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(answer)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(answer)
    do_GET=do_HEAD=do_POST=do_PUT=do_PATCH=do_DELETE=handle_request
def reserve():
    s=socket.socket();s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=s.getsockname()[1];s.close();return port
def request(method='GET',path='/',headers='',body=b''):
    return f'{method} {path} HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nConnection: close\r\nContent-Length: {len(body)}\r\n{headers}\r\n'.encode()+body
subprocess.run(['openssl','req','-x509','-newkey','ec','-pkeyopt','ec_paramgen_curve:P-256','-nodes','-days','1','-subj','/CN=localhost','-addext','subjectAltName=DNS:localhost','-keyout','key.pem','-out','cert.pem'],capture_output=True,check=True)
up=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler);up.daemon_threads=False
thread=threading.Thread(target=up.serve_forever,kwargs={'poll_interval':.01});thread.start();port=reserve()
prefix=root/'nginx';prefix.mkdir();(prefix/'temp').mkdir()
config=pathlib.Path('gateway.conf').read_text().replace('@PORT@',str(port)).replace('@ROOT@',str(root)).replace('@UPSTREAM@',str(up.server_port))
(prefix/'nginx.conf').write_text('worker_processes 1; daemon off; master_process on; pid '+str(prefix/'nginx.pid')+';\nerror_log '+str(prefix/'error.log')+' notice;\nevents { worker_connections 64; }\nhttp { access_log off; '+''.join(kind+'_temp_path '+str(prefix/'temp')+'; ' for kind in ['client_body','proxy','fastcgi','uwsgi','scgi'])+'\n'+config+'\n}\n')
process=None;log=None
try:
    checked=subprocess.run(['nginx','-t','-p',str(prefix)+'/', '-c',str(prefix/'nginx.conf')],capture_output=True,text=True);assert checked.returncode==0,checked.stderr
    log=open(prefix/'process.log','wb');process=subprocess.Popen(['nginx','-p',str(prefix)+'/', '-c',str(prefix/'nginx.conf')],stdout=log,stderr=log)
    for _ in range(100):
        try:
            with socket.create_connection(('127.0.0.1',port),timeout=.02):break
        except OSError:time.sleep(.01)
    else:raise AssertionError('gateway not listening')
    base=['openssl','s_client','-connect',f'127.0.0.1:{port}','-servername','localhost','-tls1_3','-verify_return_error','-verify_hostname','localhost','-CAfile','cert.pem','-quiet','-ign_eof']
    def normal(data,session=None):
        args=base+(['-sess_out',session] if session else [])
        r=subprocess.run(args,input=data,capture_output=True,timeout=3)
        assert r.returncode==0 and b'HTTP/1.1' in r.stdout,(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
        return r.stdout
    def early(data,session):
        pathlib.Path('early-request.bin').write_bytes(data)
        r=subprocess.run(base+['-sess_in',session,'-early_data','early-request.bin'],input=b'',capture_output=True,timeout=3)
        assert r.returncode==0 and b'HTTP/1.1' in r.stdout,(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
        return r.stdout
    # Each first connection obtains a fresh TLS1.3 ticket. Verify advertised 0-RTT capability.
    def ticket(name):
        reply=normal(request(path='/ticket'),name);assert b' 200 ' in reply
        decoded=subprocess.run(['openssl','sess_id','-in',name,'-text','-noout'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
        assert 'TLSv1.3' in decoded and 'Max Early Data: 0' not in decoded and 'Max Early Data:' in decoded,decoded
    for method in ['POST','PUT','PATCH','DELETE']:
        ticket('write.session');before=len(seen)
        reply=early(request(method,'/mutate',body=b'value=1'),'write.session')
        assert b' 425 ' in reply and b'X-Observed-Early: 1' in reply,('early write not rejected',method,reply)
        assert len(seen)==before,'unsafe early request reached backend'
        # Application retries after completing a normal authenticated handshake, exactly once.
        reply=normal(request(method,'/mutate',body=b'value=1'))
        assert b' 200 ' in reply and len(seen)==before+1
        assert seen[-1]['method']==method and seen[-1]['body']=='value=1' and seen[-1]['early'] is None
    ticket('read.session');before=len(seen);reply=early(request('GET','/read'),'read.session')
    assert b' 200 ' in reply and b'X-Observed-Early: 1' in reply and len(seen)==before+1
    assert seen[-1]['early']=='1'
    before=len(seen);reply=normal(request('POST','/mutate',headers='Early-Data: 1\r\n',body=b'normal'))
    assert b' 200 ' in reply and len(seen)==before+1 and seen[-1]['early'] is None,'untrusted HTTP header treated as TLS evidence'
    pathlib.Path('verified-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps({'upstream':seen,'tls':'TLSv1.3','unsafe_early_status':425,'safe_early_status':200},indent=2))
finally:
    if process is not None:
        if process.poll() is None:
            process.send_signal(signal.SIGQUIT)
            try:process.wait(timeout=3)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait(timeout=1)
        assert process.returncode==0,process.returncode
    if log is not None:log.close()
    up.shutdown();up.server_close();thread.join(1);assert not thread.is_alive()
print('PASS: actual TLS1.3 early data denied before writes, safe read and post-handshake retry verified')
